name: You Look Lonely, I Can Fix That: The AI Hologram Video
blurb: You look lonely, I can fix that is the line of a giant hologram that leans down to a lonely person in a rainy neon city.

prompts.text:

A colossal holographic projection of the person in [Image 1], keeping their exact outfit and appearance unchanged, but with a translucent purple digital texture. They are gigantic, lean down from the sky and reach out their index finger to touch a small silhouette of the person in [Image 2], who stands on a rainy futuristic bridge. The person in [Image 2] keeps their exact original clothes and look. Dramatic cyberpunk atmosphere, volumetric purple and violet neon lighting, wet surfaces, heavy rain, emotional connection, massive difference in scale, 8k resolution, photorealistic masterpiece. The one on the bridge looks straight at the giant, with emphasis on the holographic effect of the giant.

The giant hologram is the person in [Image 1], in every frame: copy the exact face from [Image 1] (the face shape, eye color and eye shape, eyebrows, nose, mouth, skin tone, age, hair color, hair length and hairstyle, and any beard, moustache, glasses or freckles). Only the light changes: a soft see-through glow with faint scan lines; the face stays clear and recognizable through the glow, never another face. The one on the bridge is the person in [Image 2], in every frame: copy the exact face from [Image 2] (the face shape, eye color and eye shape, eyebrows, nose, mouth, skin tone, age, hair color, hair length and hairstyle, and any beard, moustache, glasses or freckles). Never blend their faces. Each face stays the same from the first frame to the last, so their friends recognize them at once. If an image shows an animal, that one is that animal with its own face, fur and markings, not a person.

0-3 s: a wide, low shot from behind the small figure of [Image 2] on the wet bridge at night: between dark towers in fog and rain, the giant hologram of [Image 1] leans down out of the sky toward them, one huge hand reaching out.
3-6 s: a close-up of [Image 2] from the front, rain on the face, looking up in wonder, purple neon light on the wet skin. The face is large and sharp: exactly the face from [Image 2].
6-9.5 s: the giant, glowing face of the hologram fills the frame, soft and kind, the small dark silhouette of [Image 2] in front of it. The hologram says slowly and softly, the lips moving in sync: "You look lonely. I can fix that." The face is exactly the face from [Image 1].
9.5-12 s: back to a close-up of [Image 2]: the giant fingertip glows just above them, its light falls on their face, and a small smile starts.

Audio: rain, a deep city hum, a slow synth pad, and the hologram's soft, warm voice with a light echo. Only the hologram speaks, one time. Exactly two people: the hologram and the one on the bridge, no other people. No text, no subtitles, no logos, no brand names, no readable signs, no watermark.
